q: 姐姐游泳___比我快多了。
zh: 姐姐游泳游得比我快多了。
py: jiě jie yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
en: My older sister swims much faster than I do.
why: 游泳 has the object built in, so only 游 is repeated: 游泳游得比我快多了. 得 right after 泳 is wrong.

q: 他咳嗽___晚上睡不着觉。
zh: 他咳嗽得晚上睡不着觉。
py: tā ké sou de wǎn shang shuì bù zháo jiào
en: He coughs so much that he can't sleep at night.
why: The extent of the coughing leads to a result, 睡不着觉, so 得. 地 would make 睡不着觉 the manner of coughing, which makes no sense.

zh: 我累得一句话都不想说。
py: wǒ lèi de yī jù huà dōu bù xiǎng shuō
en: I'm so tired I don't even want to say a word.
why: 累得 introduces the result clause 一句话都不想说. 得 sits directly after the adjective 累.

s: 他今天不起得早。
s_py: tā jīn tiān bù qǐ de zǎo
zh: 他今天起得不早。
py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de bù zǎo
en: He didn't get up early today.
why: With 得 the negative goes on the judgement, after 得: 起得不早. 不起得 is never used.

s: 病人慢慢地睁开了眼睛。
zh: 病人慢慢地睁开了眼睛。
py: bìng rén màn màn de zhēng kāi le yǎn jing
en: The patient slowly opened his eyes.
why: 慢慢 is the manner of 睁开 and stands before the verb, so 地 is correct.

s: 这位医生看病看得非常仔细。
zh: 这位医生看病看得非常仔细。
py: zhè wèi yī shēng kàn bìng kàn de fēi cháng zǐ xì
en: This doctor examines patients very carefully.
why: 看病 has an object, so the verb is repeated before 得: 看病看得非常仔细. This is correct.

q: 虽然医生说我的病不严重，但是我这几天一直睡___很差。
zh: 虽然医生说我的病不严重，但是我这几天一直睡得很差。
py: suī rán yī shēng shuō wǒ de bìng bù yán zhòng dàn shì wǒ zhè jǐ tiān yī zhí shuì de hěn chà
en: Although the doctor says my illness isn't serious, I've been sleeping badly these days.
why: 睡 + 得 + 很差 judges the quality of sleep. 地 would sit before a verb, and no noun follows for 的.

s: 雪慢慢得融化了。
s_py: xuě màn màn de róng huà le
zh: 雪慢慢地融化了。
py: xuě màn màn de róng huà le
en: The snow slowly melted.
why: 慢慢 describes the manner of 融化 and precedes the verb, so 地. 得 would have to follow 融化.

s: 穿白衣服的是我们的医生。
zh: 穿白衣服的是我们的医生。
py: chuān bái yī fu de shì wǒ men de yī shēng
en: The one in white is our doctor.
why: 穿白衣服 modifies an understood noun (the person), so 的 is correct even though the noun is left out. 我们的医生 uses 的 for ownership.

q: 这是我___药。
zh: 这是我的药。
py: zhè shì wǒ de yào
en: This is my medicine.
why: Owner + 的 + noun. The word after the gap is the noun 药, so 得 and 地, which belong with verbs, cannot fit.

q: 今天太热了，我热___不想吃饭。
zh: 今天太热了，我热得不想吃饭。
py: jīn tiān tài rè le wǒ rè de bù xiǎng chī fàn
en: It's too hot today; I'm so hot I don't feel like eating.
why: 热 + 得 + result clause: 热得不想吃饭. 不想吃饭 is the result of the heat, not the manner of any action, so 地 is out.

q: 我喜欢凉快___秋天。
zh: 我喜欢凉快的秋天。
py: wǒ xǐ huan liáng kuai de qiū tiān
en: I like the cool autumn.
why: 秋天 is a noun, so the describing word 凉快 joins it with 的. 得 needs a verb or adjective before it and a comment after it, and 地 needs a verb after it.

q: 孩子们高高兴兴___玩雪。
zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地玩雪。
py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de wán xuě
en: The children happily played in the snow.
why: 高高兴兴 is the manner of 玩雪 and comes before the verb, so 地. 得 would require 玩 first, as in 玩得高高兴兴.

s: 他很认真地吃完了医生开的药。
zh: 他很认真地吃完了医生开的药。
py: tā hěn rèn zhēn de chī wán le yī shēng kāi de yào
en: He conscientiously took all the medicine the doctor prescribed.
why: Both particles are right: 认真地 stands before the verb 吃完, and 开的药 is clause + 的 + noun.

q: 我饿___肚子都叫了。
zh: 我饿得肚子都叫了。
py: wǒ è de dù zi dōu jiào le
en: I'm so hungry that my stomach is rumbling.
why: 饿 + 得 + clause: 肚子都叫了 is the result of being hungry. 的 would need a noun, which 肚子 is not describing.

q: 医生认真___给我检查身体。
zh: 医生认真地给我检查身体。
py: yī shēng rèn zhēn de gěi wǒ jiǎn chá shēn tǐ
en: The doctor examined me carefully.
why: 认真 is the manner of the action 检查, and the verb phrase follows, so 地. 得 belongs after a verb with a judgement.

q: 外面的雪下___路都看不见了。
zh: 外面的雪下得路都看不见了。
py: wài miàn de xuě xià de lù dōu kàn bù jiàn le
en: It snowed so much that the roads can't be seen anymore.
why: 下 + 得 + a result clause with its own subject 路. 地 would need a verb of manner right after it, but 路都看不见了 is a result.

q: 雨下得太大了，我们今天肯定回___去了。
zh: 雨下得太大了，我们今天肯定回不去了。
py: yǔ xià de tài dà le wǒ men jīn tiān kěn dìng huí bù qù le
en: It's raining so hard that we definitely can't go back today.
why: Rain too heavy means 'cannot': 回不去了. 得 would say we can get back, contradicting the first clause.

s: 昨天的雪下得真大。
zh: 昨天的雪下得真大。
py: zuó tiān de xuě xià de zhēn dà
en: It snowed really heavily yesterday.
why: 的 links 昨天 to the noun 雪, and 得 links the verb 下 to the judgement 真大. Each particle is in its proper spot.

s: 他今天起得比平时早。
zh: 他今天起得比平时早。
py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de bǐ píng shí zǎo
en: He got up earlier than usual today.
why: 起 + 得 + comment (here a comparison) is correct. The comment after 得 does not need 很.

q: 他认真___吃药。
zh: 他认真地吃药。
py: tā rèn zhēn de chī yào
en: He takes his medicine conscientiously.
why: 认真 describes the manner of the action 吃药, so 地 goes between them. 得 comes after a verb, not before one.

q: 冬天很冷，我要穿厚___衣服。
zh: 冬天很冷，我要穿厚的衣服。
py: dōng tiān hěn lěng wǒ yào chuān hòu de yī fu
en: It's cold in winter, so I need to wear thick clothes.
why: 厚 describes the noun 衣服, so the link is 的. 得 and 地 would need a verb or complement around them, but 衣服 is a plain noun.

q: 她小心___走在雪地上。
zh: 她小心地走在雪地上。
py: tā xiǎo xīn de zǒu zài xuě dì shàng
en: She walked carefully on the snow.
why: 小心 is the manner of walking and stands before the verb 走, so 地. 得 would need 走 first.

q: 天太黑了，我们看___见路。
zh: 天太黑了，我们看不见路。
py: tiān tài hēi le wǒ men kàn bù jiàn lù
en: It's too dark; we can't see the road.
why: 太黑 means we cannot see, so 得 turns into 不: 看不见. 看得见 would claim the opposite.

q: 我昨天晚上睡___不好。
zh: 我昨天晚上睡得不好。
py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de bù hǎo
en: I didn't sleep well last night.
why: Verb + 得 + judgement: 睡得不好. 的 needs a noun after it, and 地 needs a verb after it; 不好 is neither.

q: 他很快___吃完了药。
zh: 他很快地吃完了药。
py: tā hěn kuài de chī wán le yào
en: He quickly finished taking the medicine.
why: 很快 describes how he took the medicine and stands before the verb 吃, so 地. 得 would have to follow the verb.

q: 感冒___时候要多喝水。
zh: 感冒的时候要多喝水。
py: gǎn mào de shí hou yào duō hē shuǐ
en: When you have a cold, drink plenty of water.
why: 感冒 is a verb, but the next word is the noun 时候, so the time clause is joined with 的. 地 and 得 are ruled out by the following noun.

q: 他跳舞___真好看。
zh: 他跳舞跳得真好看。
py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de zhēn hǎo kàn
en: He dances beautifully.
why: 跳舞 is verb + object, so 跳 is repeated: 跳舞跳得真好看. 得 directly after 舞 is not possible.

q: 小王跑___很慢，因为他的腿疼。
zh: 小王跑得很慢，因为他的腿疼。
py: xiǎo wáng pǎo de hěn màn yīn wèi tā de tuǐ téng
en: Xiao Wang runs slowly because his leg hurts.
why: 很慢 judges how he runs and follows the verb 跑, so 得. 地 would put the manner word before the verb instead.

s: 今天太阳升地很早。
s_py: jīn tiān tài yáng shēng de hěn zǎo
zh: 今天太阳升得很早。
py: jīn tiān tài yáng shēng de hěn zǎo
en: The sun rose very early today.
why: 升 is a verb and 很早 is the judgement after it, so 得. 地 cannot follow a verb to introduce a complement.

q: 她每天都很努力___锻炼身体。
zh: 她每天都很努力地锻炼身体。
py: tā měi tiān dōu hěn nǔ lì de duàn liàn shēn tǐ
en: She works hard at exercising every day.
why: 很努力 is the manner of the verb 锻炼, so 地. The same word after a verb would take 得 instead.

q: 她说汉语___很流利，没有人觉得她是外国人。
zh: 她说汉语说得很流利，没有人觉得她是外国人。
py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì méi yǒu rén jué de tā shì wài guó rén
en: She speaks Chinese so fluently that nobody thinks she's a foreigner.
why: With the object 汉语 the verb is repeated: 说汉语说得很流利. 得 cannot attach to 汉语.

q: 感冒好了以后，我又闻___到花香了。
zh: 感冒好了以后，我又闻得到花香了。
py: gǎn mào hǎo le yǐ hòu wǒ yòu wén de dào huā xiāng le
en: After my cold got better, I could smell the flowers again.
why: Recovered from the cold, so 'can smell again': 闻得到. 闻不到 would mean the nose is still blocked, which 好了 and 又 rule out.

q: 你要好好___休息，不要熬夜。
zh: 你要好好地休息，不要熬夜。
py: nǐ yào hǎo hǎo de xiū xi bù yào áo yè
en: You must rest properly; don't stay up late.
why: 好好 describes how to rest and stands before the verb 休息, so 地. 得 would have to follow a verb.

s: 我妈妈做饭得很好吃。
s_py: wǒ mā ma zuò fàn de hěn hǎo chī
zh: 我妈妈做饭做得很好吃。
py: wǒ mā ma zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo chī
en: My mum cooks very tasty food.
why: 得 cannot follow the object 饭. The verb 做 is repeated: 做饭做得很好吃.

zh: 医生说的话我听得懂。
py: yī shēng shuō de huà wǒ tīng de dǒng
en: I can understand what the doctor says.
why: 医生说的话 is clause + 的 + noun, topicalised or after the verb; 听得懂 keeps 得 between the verb and the result.

q: 他锻炼___很努力，所以身体越来越好。
zh: 他锻炼得很努力，所以身体越来越好。
py: tā duàn liàn de hěn nǔ lì suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo
en: He exercises very diligently, so his health is getting better and better.
why: Here 努力 follows the verb 锻炼 as a judgement of how he does it, so 得. Before the verb it would be 地.

s: 弟弟很好地游泳。
s_py: dì di hěn hǎo de yóu yǒng
zh: 弟弟游泳游得很好。
py: dì di yóu yǒng yóu de hěn hǎo
en: My younger brother swims well.
why: English 'well' judges the swimming, so Chinese puts it after the verb with 得. 很好地游泳 is not Chinese.

q: 地上有一层厚厚___雪。
zh: 地上有一层厚厚的雪。
py: dì shàng yǒu yī céng hòu hòu de xuě
en: There is a thick layer of snow on the ground.
why: The doubled 厚厚 describes the noun 雪, so 的. The same doubled word before a verb would take 地.

q: 她唱歌___很好听。
zh: 她唱歌唱得很好听。
py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
en: She sings beautifully.
why: With an object (歌), the verb is repeated: 唱歌唱得很好听. 得 cannot attach to the object, and 的 is wrong before an adjective.

q: 他的感冒好___真快。
zh: 他的感冒好得真快。
py: tā de gǎn mào hǎo de zhēn kuài
en: His cold got better really fast.
why: An adjective or verb of change + 得 + comment on speed: 好得真快. 的 or 地 would not link 好 with the adjective 真快.

s: 夏天是我最喜欢地季节。
s_py: xià tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jì jié
zh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节。
py: xià tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jì jié
en: Summer is my favourite season.
why: 最喜欢 describes the noun 季节, so 的. 地 can only come before a verb.

q: 医生说汉语___不太流利，但是我们听得懂。
zh: 医生说汉语说得不太流利，但是我们听得懂。
py: yī shēng shuō hàn yǔ shuō de bù tài liú lì dàn shì wǒ men tīng de dǒng
en: The doctor doesn't speak Chinese very fluently, but we can understand him.
why: With the object 汉语, the verb must be repeated: 说汉语说得不太流利. 得 cannot follow 汉语 directly.

q: 早上起来，窗外白白___一片，昨晚下雪了。
zh: 早上起来，窗外白白的一片，昨晚下雪了。
py: zǎo shang qǐ lái chuāng wài bái bái de yī piàn zuó wǎn xià xuě le
en: When I got up in the morning, outside the window was a stretch of white; it snowed last night.
why: 白白 describes the stretch (一片) outside, so 的. There is no verb after the gap for 地.

q: 他吃饭___很慢。
zh: 他吃饭吃得很慢。
py: tā chī fàn chī de hěn màn
en: He eats slowly.
why: 吃饭 has an object, so the verb 吃 returns before 得: 吃饭吃得很慢. 吃饭得很慢 breaks the rule that 得 must follow the verb.

q: 那个每天早上在公园里打太极拳___老人看起来身体特别好。
zh: 那个每天早上在公园里打太极拳的老人看起来身体特别好。
py: nà gè měi tiān zǎo shang zài gōng yuán lǐ dǎ tài jí quán de lǎo rén kàn qǐ lái shēn tǐ tè bié hǎo
en: The old man who does tai chi in the park every morning looks to be in excellent health.
why: A long clause ending in a verb phrase still modifies the noun 老人 with 的. Verb + 得 would be followed by a judgement, not by 老人.

q: 春天的雨细细的，轻轻___落在窗户上。
zh: 春天的雨细细的，轻轻地落在窗户上。
py: chūn tiān de yǔ xì xì de qīng qīng de luò zài chuāng hu shàng
en: The spring rain is fine and falls softly on the window.
why: 轻轻 modifies the verb 落, so 地. 细细的 earlier is a predicate before a comma, which takes 的.

q: 医生给了我一张很长___药单。
zh: 医生给了我一张很长的药单。
py: yī shēng gěi le wǒ yī zhāng hěn cháng de yào dān
en: The doctor gave me a very long prescription.
why: 很长 describes the noun 药单, so 的. Both 得 and 地 need a verb next to them, and 药单 is a noun.

q: 医生轻轻___按了按我的肚子。
zh: 医生轻轻地按了按我的肚子。
py: yī shēng qīng qīng de àn le àn wǒ de dù zi
en: The doctor gently pressed my stomach.
why: 轻轻 describes the manner of pressing and stands before the verb, so 地. Doubling does not change that.

s: 我喝了奶奶煮得姜汤。
s_py: wǒ hē le nǎi nai zhǔ de jiāng tāng
zh: 我喝了奶奶煮的姜汤。
py: wǒ hē le nǎi nai zhǔ de jiāng tāng
en: I drank the ginger soup Grandma cooked.
why: The clause 奶奶煮 describes the noun 姜汤, so the link is 的, not 得. 得 needs a judgement after it.

q: 天气太冷，手都冻红了，我拿___住笔。
zh: 天气太冷，手都冻红了，我拿不住笔。
py: tiān qì tài lěng shǒu dōu dòng hóng le wǒ ná bù zhù bǐ
en: It's so cold and my hands are so frozen red that I can't hold the pen.
why: The result of the cold is that I cannot hold the pen: 拿不住. 拿得住 would mean the opposite.

q: 妈妈把生病的孩子紧紧___抱在怀里。
zh: 妈妈把生病的孩子紧紧地抱在怀里。
py: mā ma bǎ shēng bìng de hái zi jǐn jǐn de bào zài huái lǐ
en: Mum held the sick child tightly in her arms.
why: 紧紧 is the manner of holding and precedes the verb 抱, so 地. 得 cannot come before the verb.

q: 病人的房间被护士打扫___干干净净。
zh: 病人的房间被护士打扫得干干净净。
py: bìng rén de fáng jiān bèi hù shi dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
en: The patient's room was cleaned spotless by the nurse.
why: 打扫 + 得 + 干干净净 is a result complement, so 得. Doubling does not turn it into 地 or 的.

q: 外面冷___我不想出门。
zh: 外面冷得我不想出门。
py: wài miàn lěng de wǒ bù xiǎng chū mén
en: It's so cold outside that I don't want to go out.
why: 冷 + 得 + a clause with its own subject 我 gives the 'so cold that' pattern. 地 and 的 cannot introduce a result clause.

s: 医生写的字我看得不懂。
s_py: yī shēng xiě de zì wǒ kàn de bù dǒng
zh: 医生写的字我看不懂。
py: yī shēng xiě de zì wǒ kàn bù dǒng
en: I can't read the characters the doctor wrote.
why: 'Cannot' is 看不懂 (不 replaces 得). 看得不懂 mixes the two.

q: 药太苦了，我吃___下去。
zh: 药太苦了，我吃不下去。
py: yào tài kǔ le wǒ chī bù xià qù
en: The medicine is too bitter; I can't get it down.
why: 太苦 signals 'cannot', so the negative potential 吃不下去. 得 would say I can swallow it, contradicting 太苦.

q: 雨声太大，我听___见你说话。
zh: 雨声太大，我听不见你说话。
py: yǔ shēng tài dà wǒ tīng bù jiàn nǐ shuō huà
en: The rain is so loud I can't hear you.
why: The rain is too loud, so the meaning is 'cannot': 听不见. 得 would say you can hear, which the situation contradicts.

q: 护士写___很清楚，我一下子就看懂了。
zh: 护士写得很清楚，我一下子就看懂了。
py: hù shi xiě de hěn qīng chu wǒ yī xià zi jiù kàn dǒng le
en: The nurse wrote it very clearly, so I understood at a glance.
why: 清楚 judges how she wrote, so 写得很清楚. 的 would need a noun after it.

s: 他咳嗽得一晚上都没睡好。
zh: 他咳嗽得一晚上都没睡好。
py: tā ké sou de yī wǎn shang dōu méi shuì hǎo
en: He coughed so much that he didn't sleep well all night.
why: Verb + 得 + result clause is correct. 得 here introduces the result of the coughing, not a manner.

s: 听到自己的病好了，他高兴得哭了。
zh: 听到自己的病好了，他高兴得哭了。
py: tīng dào zì jǐ de bìng hǎo le tā gāo xìng de kū le
en: Hearing that he was cured, he was so happy he cried.
why: 高兴得哭了 is the extent pattern: so happy that he cried. The result 哭了 follows 得, which is correct.

q: 山上的雾很大，我们爬上去也看___到风景。
zh: 山上的雾很大，我们爬上去也看不到风景。
py: shān shàng de wù hěn dà wǒ men pá shàng qù yě kàn bù dào fēng jǐng
en: The fog on the mountain is thick; even if we climb up, we won't see the scenery.
why: Thick fog plus 也 (even if) leads to 'cannot see': 看不到. 看得到 would not fit after 雾很大.

q: 护士耐心___给孩子量体温。
zh: 护士耐心地给孩子量体温。
py: hù shi nài xīn de gěi hái zi liáng tǐ wēn
en: The nurse patiently took the child's temperature.
why: 耐心 describes how she did the task, so it takes 地 before the verb phrase. 得 would place the description after a verb.

q: 弟弟踢足球___不太好，因为膝盖受过伤。
zh: 弟弟踢足球踢得不太好，因为膝盖受过伤。
py: dì di tī zú qiú tī de bù tài hǎo yīn wèi xī gài shòu guo shāng
en: My younger brother doesn't play football very well because he once injured his knee.
why: 踢足球 has an object, so 踢 is repeated before 得, and the negative goes after it: 踢得不太好.

q: 这碗汤不多，你一个人喝___完。
zh: 这碗汤不多，你一个人喝得完。
py: zhè wǎn tāng bù duō nǐ yī gè rén hē de wán
en: This bowl of soup isn't much; you can finish it by yourself.
why: 不多 tells us it is manageable, so 'can': 喝得完. 喝不完 would be right for a huge amount of soup.

s: 我爷爷走路走得很慢。
zh: 我爷爷走路走得很慢。
py: wǒ yé ye zǒu lù zǒu de hěn màn
en: My grandpa walks very slowly.
why: 走路 has an object, so the verb is repeated before 得. This is the correct pattern, not a mistake.

q: 这几天雨下___不太多。
zh: 这几天雨下得不太多。
py: zhè jǐ tiān yǔ xià de bù tài duō
en: It hasn't rained much these last few days.
why: The negative goes after the particle: 下得不太多. 得 follows the verb 下 and introduces the judgement 不太多. 的 or 地 cannot introduce a degree comment.

zh: 护士轻轻地扶起了老人。
py: hù shi qīng qīng de fú qǐ le lǎo rén
en: The nurse gently helped the old man up.
why: 轻轻地 is a manner adverbial and goes right before the verb 扶起, after the subject. It cannot follow 扶起 or come after 了.

q: 今天天很晴，我们看___见月亮。
zh: 今天天很晴，我们看得见月亮。
py: jīn tiān tiān hěn qíng wǒ men kàn de jiàn yuè liang
en: It's very clear today, so we can see the moon.
why: A clear sky means 'can see', so verb + 得 + 见: 看得见. 不 would mean the moon is hidden, which a clear sky rules out.

q: 今年冬天来___很晚。
zh: 今年冬天来得很晚。
py: jīn nián dōng tiān lái de hěn wǎn
en: Winter came very late this year.
why: 来 + 得 + 很晚 judges the timing of the arrival. 地 belongs before a verb, and no noun follows for 的.

q: 北京冬天那种干燥又寒冷___空气让我的嗓子很不舒服。
zh: 北京冬天那种干燥又寒冷的空气让我的嗓子很不舒服。
py: běi jīng dōng tiān nà zhǒng gān zào yòu hán lěng de kōng qì ràng wǒ de sǎng zi hěn bù shū fu
en: The dry, freezing air of Beijing winters makes my throat very uncomfortable.
why: 干燥又寒冷 describes the noun 空气, so 的 is required. 地 would need the next word to be a verb, and 得 would need a comment after it.

s: 他忙地没有时间吃药。
s_py: tā máng de méi yǒu shí jiān chī yào
zh: 他忙得没有时间吃药。
py: tā máng de méi yǒu shí jiān chī yào
en: He is so busy that he has no time to take his medicine.
why: 忙 is a state, and 没有时间吃药 is the result, so 得. 地 would make 忙 a manner of an action.

zh: 奶奶打太极拳打得很好。
py: nǎi nai dǎ tài jí quán dǎ de hěn hǎo
en: Grandma does tai chi very well.
why: The verb 打 is repeated before 得 when there is an object. 打得 must follow 太极拳 and cannot come right after 奶奶.

zh: 妈妈煮的姜汤很热。
py: mā ma zhǔ de jiāng tāng hěn rè
en: The ginger soup Mum made is very hot.
why: The clause 妈妈煮 + 的 modifies the noun 姜汤, which is the subject of 很热.

s: 这是一个又热又湿的夏天。
zh: 这是一个又热又湿的夏天。
py: zhè shì yī gè yòu rè yòu shī de xià tiān
en: This is a hot and humid summer.
why: 又热又湿 describes the noun 夏天, so 的 is correct.

q: 夏天的太阳晒___我的皮肤又红又疼。
zh: 夏天的太阳晒得我的皮肤又红又疼。
py: xià tiān de tài yáng shài de wǒ de pí fū yòu hóng yòu téng
en: The summer sun burned my skin red and sore.
why: 晒 + 得 + result: the skin ended up red and sore. 地 would describe how the sun shines, which does not fit a result on the skin.

q: 今天风刮___很大。
zh: 今天风刮得很大。
py: jīn tiān fēng guā de hěn dà
en: The wind is blowing hard today.
why: 刮 is a verb and 很大 comments on how it blows, so 得. 的 would require a noun to follow.

s: 医生说的话你听得懂吗？
zh: 医生说的话你听得懂吗？
py: yī shēng shuō de huà nǐ tīng de dǒng ma
en: Can you understand what the doctor says?
why: 说的话 is clause + 的 + noun, and 听得懂 is the potential form. Both uses are correct.

s: 医生认真得检查了我的耳朵。
s_py: yī shēng rèn zhēn de jiǎn chá le wǒ de ěr duo
zh: 医生认真地检查了我的耳朵。
py: yī shēng rèn zhēn de jiǎn chá le wǒ de ěr duo
en: The doctor examined my ears carefully.
why: 认真 is the manner of the verb 检查 and stands before it, so 地. 得 only follows a verb or adjective.

q: 她小心___把热汤端到病人面前。
zh: 她小心地把热汤端到病人面前。
py: tā xiǎo xīn de bǎ rè tāng duān dào bìng rén miàn qián
en: She carefully carried the hot soup to the patient.
why: 小心 is the manner of the whole action 把汤端到病人面前, standing before the verb phrase, so 地.

s: 我不喜欢下雨的星期天。
zh: 我不喜欢下雨的星期天。
py: wǒ bù xǐ huan xià yǔ de xīng qī tiān
en: I don't like rainy Sundays.
why: A verb phrase before 的 is fine when a noun follows: 下雨的星期天. The sentence is correct because 的 joins a clause to the noun 星期天.

s: 药太多了，我不吃得完。
s_py: yào tài duō le wǒ bù chī de wán
zh: 药太多了，我吃不完。
py: yào tài duō le wǒ chī bù wán
en: There is too much medicine; I can't finish it.
why: The negative of 吃得完 replaces 得 with 不: 吃不完. 不 is not put before the verb.

q: 我妈妈睡觉___很早。
zh: 我妈妈睡觉睡得很早。
py: wǒ mā ma shuì jiào shuì de hěn zǎo
en: My mum goes to bed very early.
why: 睡觉 is verb + object, so repeat the verb before 得: 睡觉睡得很早. A bare 得 after 觉 is wrong.

q: 奶奶包___饺子很好吃。
zh: 奶奶包的饺子很好吃。
py: nǎi nai bāo de jiǎo zi hěn hǎo chī
en: The dumplings Grandma made are delicious.
why: After 包 comes the noun 饺子, so the clause 奶奶包 modifies it with 的. 得 would be followed by a judgement such as 很好, not by a noun.

q: 医生仔细___看了看我的喉咙，然后开了药。
zh: 医生仔细地看了看我的喉咙，然后开了药。
py: yī shēng zǐ xì de kàn le kàn wǒ de hóu lóng rán hòu kāi le yào
en: The doctor looked carefully at my throat and then prescribed medicine.
why: 仔细 is the manner of 看, so 地 goes before the verb. 得 would require 看 before the particle.

q: 太阳慢慢___升起来了。
zh: 太阳慢慢地升起来了。
py: tài yáng màn màn de shēng qǐ lái le
en: The sun slowly rose.
why: Doubled adjective before a verb: 慢慢地升. 得 would need the verb first, as in 升得很慢.

q: 我最怕下大雨___晚上一个人回家。
zh: 我最怕下大雨的晚上一个人回家。
py: wǒ zuì pà xià dà yǔ de wǎn shang yī gè rén huí jiā
en: I'm most afraid of going home alone on nights when it pours.
why: 下大雨 modifies the noun 晚上, so 的. The word after the gap is a noun, which cannot take 地 or 得.

q: 这个城市春天___天气最舒服。
zh: 这个城市春天的天气最舒服。
py: zhè gè chéng shì chūn tiān de tiān qì zuì shū fu
en: The weather in spring is the most comfortable in this city.
why: 春天 owns the noun 天气 (spring's weather), so 的 joins them. 地 or 得 would need a verb on one side.

q: 昨天的台风刮___很多树都倒了。
zh: 昨天的台风刮得很多树都倒了。
py: zuó tiān de tái fēng guā de hěn duō shù dōu dǎo le
en: Yesterday's typhoon blew so hard that many trees fell.
why: 刮 + 得 + result clause with its own subject 很多树. Reading 的 as a noun link fails because 很多树都倒了 is a full clause.

q: 她是一位很仔细___医生。
zh: 她是一位很仔细的医生。
py: tā shì yī wèi hěn zǐ xì de yī shēng
en: She is a very careful doctor.
why: 仔细 describes the noun 医生, so 的. 地 would be for a verb, which does not follow here.

q: 我喜欢下雪___日子。
zh: 我喜欢下雪的日子。
py: wǒ xǐ huan xià xuě de rì zi
en: I like days when it snows.
why: 下雪 is a clause that describes the noun 日子 (days on which it snows), so 的. 得 and 地 do not link a clause to a noun.

s: 她轻轻地摸了摸孩子发烫的额头。
zh: 她轻轻地摸了摸孩子发烫的额头。
py: tā qīng qīng de mō le mō hái zi fā tàng de é tóu
en: She gently touched the child's burning forehead.
why: 轻轻地 precedes the verb 摸, and 发烫的 describes the noun 额头, so both particles are correct.

q: 这家医院的医生很多，今天下午你一定挂___到号。
zh: 这家医院的医生很多，今天下午你一定挂得到号。
py: zhè jiā yī yuàn de yī shēng hěn duō jīn tiān xià wǔ nǐ yī dìng guà de dào hào
en: This hospital has many doctors, so you will surely get a number this afternoon.
why: Many doctors and 一定 point to 'can': 挂得到号. 挂不到号 contradicts the optimistic context.

q: 这是医生昨天给我开___药，一天吃三次。
zh: 这是医生昨天给我开的药，一天吃三次。
py: zhè shì yī shēng zuó tiān gěi wǒ kāi de yào yī tiān chī sān cì
en: This is the medicine the doctor prescribed for me yesterday; I take it three times a day.
why: The whole clause 医生昨天给我开 describes the noun 药, so 的. Because a noun follows, 得 (which expects a judgement) is wrong.

q: 医生很清楚___告诉我，这种药一天只能吃两次。
zh: 医生很清楚地告诉我，这种药一天只能吃两次。
py: yī shēng hěn qīng chu de gào su wǒ zhè zhǒng yào yī tiān zhǐ néng chī liǎng cì
en: The doctor told me clearly that this medicine can only be taken twice a day.
why: 很清楚 sits before the verb 告诉 as its manner, so 地. After a verb the same word would take 得.

q: 昨天下午来看病___人很多。
zh: 昨天下午来看病的人很多。
py: zuó tiān xià wǔ lái kàn bìng de rén hěn duō
en: Lots of people came to see a doctor yesterday afternoon.
why: 来看病 describes the noun 人, so 的. 得 would need a complement like 很快 right after it, but a noun follows.

q: 这是奶奶给我买___帽子。
zh: 这是奶奶给我买的帽子。
py: zhè shì nǎi nai gěi wǒ mǎi de mào zi
en: This is the hat Grandma bought for me.
why: The clause 奶奶给我买 describes the noun 帽子, so 的 joins them even though a verb stands before the gap. 得 would need a result or judgement after it.

s: 她游泳得很好。
s_py: tā yóu yǒng de hěn hǎo
zh: 她游泳游得很好。
py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn hǎo
en: She swims very well.
why: 得 must follow the verb, not the object. With 游泳 the verb 游 is repeated before 得.

q: 她安静___坐在床边。
zh: 她安静地坐在床边。
py: tā ān jìng de zuò zài chuáng biān
en: She sat quietly beside the bed.
why: 安静 describes how she sat, and a verb follows, so 地. 得 does not go before a verb, and 着 is not a linker.

q: 奶奶最近走___不太稳，我们要小心。
zh: 奶奶最近走得不太稳，我们要小心。
py: nǎi nai zuì jìn zǒu de bù tài wěn wǒ men yào xiǎo xīn
en: Grandma hasn't been walking very steadily lately, so we have to be careful.
why: 走 + 得 + 不太稳 judges how she walks. 的 would need a noun, 地 a verb after it, and 稳 is an adjective.

q: 医生写的字太小了，我看___清楚。
zh: 医生写的字太小了，我看不清楚。
py: yī shēng xiě de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
en: The characters the doctor wrote are too small; I can't read them clearly.
why: Too small means I cannot manage it: 看不清楚. 看得清楚 would say I can see clearly, the opposite of 太小.
